title: Utility back on path A: retransfer (open transition) and stop the sets
summary: Path A is on generators after a utility outage; the utility voltage is back and stable. The design transfers in open transition (52-U and 52-GM are interlocked, never closed together): retransfer to utility, then stop the generator bus.

steps.text: Acknowledge the path A alarms in the alarm banner
Retransfer to utility (MV transfer A: Retransfer to utility)
Stop the generator bus (MV transfer A: Stop generator bus)
